name: Asset tag
idea: Condensed capitals, square ruled cells and one signal colour kept for the thing to act on, as a stamped asset tag and the cells of a drawing use them to be read at arm's length.
gives_up: Warmth. It reads as official paper, and a visitor to the landing page meets a great many capitals

drawn_from.took: Condensed capitals for names and labels, the asset code as the most prominent thing in a row, and one signal colour
A small capital label over its value in a ruled cell, two weights of line and no fills, figures of equal width

refuses: No shadows: nothing is lifted off the page
No rounded corners on boxes or panels
Orange never fills anything larger than a button
No icon without a word beside it

signature.what: Asset codes in fixed-width capitals, the heaviest thing in any row
signature.product: The first column of every table, and the heading of an asset's panel
signature.landing: The codes in the picture of the product

signature.what: Names and headings in condensed capitals, as stamped
signature.product: The product's name and every screen title
signature.landing: The headline and every section heading

meanings.accent: the one thing to do next on a screen, and nothing else
meanings.info: not visited yet, or a note

colour.product_use: Orange is on the main action and on links, and nowhere else. Everything else is ink on paper
colour.landing_use: Ink on paper, with one band of ink. Orange is on the main action only

motion.product: Nothing moves except a pressed button, which sinks by a pixel
motion.reduced: The same: there is nothing to reduce

imagery.kind: Real screens of the product, and line drawings of assets in the manner of an engineering drawing
imagery.treatment: Black line on the page colour inside a ruled border, without perspective
imagery.never: Photographs of people, or any colour but the one orange

voice.speaks_to: the crew or the supervisor, as "you"
voice.tone: Plain and exact, as one colleague to another
voice.capitalisation: Sentence case for sentences and buttons; names, labels and headings in capitals
